Feature: System Administration and Patient Management

  Scenario: Admin has option to update doctors information (VIRTUA-5-1)
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin navigates to the doctors management section
    Then the admin should see a button or link to update doctors information

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates a doctor's contact information (VIRTUA-5-2)
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the admin has navigated to the doctor's profile page
    When the admin updates the doctor's contact information to <contact_info>
    Then the system should <result>

    Examples:
      | contact_info | result                          |
      | 1234567890   | update successfully             |
      | ""           | display error message           |
      | abc          | display error message           |

  Scenario: Admin has option to update labs and chemist (VIRTUA-5-3)
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin navigates to the labs and chemist management section
    Then the admin should see a button or link to update labs and chemist

  Scenario: Admin updates lab/chemist information successfully (VIRTUA-5-4)
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the admin has navigated to the lab/chemist profile page
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist information with valid data
    Then the system should update the lab/chemist information

  Scenario: Patient can update their personal details (VIRTUA-5-5)
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to their profile page
    Then the patient should see a button or link to update personal details

  Scenario: Patient updates their personal details successfully (VIRTUA-5-6)
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has navigated to their profile page
    When the patient updates their personal details with valid data
    Then the system should update the patient's personal details

  Scenario: Patient can create appointment to visit the doctor (future date) (VIRTUA-5-7)
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has selected a doctor
    When the patient selects a future date for the appointment
    Then the system should allow the appointment to be created

  Scenario: Appointment is created and can be viewed in appointments tab (VIRTUA-5-8)
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has created an appointment
